name: Tsuyuzuki Hayuru
source:
A classmate from university. Currently in a relationship that's more than friends but less than lovers, but neither is very forward, so things aren't progressing.

Perhaps conscious of looking younger than her age, she tends to try to act more mature than she is.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698944]getchu[/url]]
